rss: US prices remain high as fuel costs squeeze household budgets
title: Fuel Costs Make Things Pricier
story: Fuel is getting more expensive and making other things cost more, too. This means families might have to spend more money than usual.
storyBig: Rising fuel prices are contributing to overall inflation, meaning a general increase in prices across various products. This impacts household budgets, putting a strain on consumer spending.
think: How can families save money when prices go up?
bull: High prices mean FIZZ and CNDY might earn more money.
bear: People might buy less candy and soda if prices get too high.

rss: 'Skimpflation' warning as tinned mackerel alternative hits more supermarket shelves
title: 'Skimpflation' Hits Snack Shelves
story: Some stores are selling less yummy snacks at the same price. This is called 'skimpflation' and it means getting less for the same money.
storyBig: 'Skimpflation' describes a situation where consumers receive less value for the same price. Retailers may use cheaper ingredients or reduce quality to maintain profit margins.
think: How would you feel if your favorite snack tasted different?
bull: Cheaper snacks might help save money.
bear: Not everyone will like the new taste of snacks.
